units.source_scale_reason: Guides are the accepted paintings at their accepted scale; every video frame keeps one fixed extraction scale and anchor.

visual_review.notes: All seven clips from H3 video on the reviewed paintings. Idle (watchful sway) and slither are retaken loops, evenly resampled around the frames the plate pulse rejected, with per-frame durations keeping the video's timing. Attack v3 is a single coiled strike with the jaws snapping shut and no fire or breath; v1 lost its recovery to plate pulses and v2 breathed fire. The harness chain that tightens to the head during the lunge is painted in attack_03 and attack_04. Cast is a ritual bow with no effect; hit, defend and death are the first takes.
